calls.note: Jumping to level 5, let's see what's here.
Plan: hop into G, walk it back onto the plate, then hop down into C and walk C through the gate.

calls.status: You are the cat now. Z to undo.

calls.note: Cat around and through the gate to the exit.

calls.status: You are the cat now. Z to undo.

calls.note: Cat under the guard, hop back, guard walks to the locked door and out.
calls.status: Out in 13 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

Guard is the paperweight, cat is already by the gate. Fetch guard, park him on the plate, hop right into cat, go down.
calls.status: Out in 13 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Easy. Next.
Only cat 1 is reachable. Cat over the pink block and into the guard; leaves cat 1 parked on the pink square right above.
calls.status: You are the guard now. Z to undo.

calls.note: Guard into cat 2, cat 2 onto plate, hop back up through the guard into cat 1.
calls.status: Back in the cat. Z to undo.

calls.note: Cat 1 around to the gate and out.
calls.status: Out in 16 turns (par!). Chapter complete: Leftovers. Press N for Gates.

calls.note: Bucket brigade was the best so far. On to Gates.
Guard wedges himself into the lower gate so it stays open, then hop up into cat and let it walk off the plate.
calls.status: Out in 9 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Doorstop trick. Next.
Spirit loops up to the guard, guard walks back down onto the plate I started on, then hop left into cat and out through gate and vent.
calls.status: Out in 12 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: That one was almost a corridor. The hint didn't matter. Next.
Guard onto the blue square, relay through the lower cat into the upper cat.
calls.status: You are the cat now. Z to undo.

calls.note: Upper cat tucks into the pink lay-by next to the guard, hop back, guard walks the top row out over the blue.
calls.status: Out in 13 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Last one asked of me. Nice relay through the stuck cat.

Plan: guard steps up, then a cat must land on the plate and hop straight up into him. That needs a relay cat parked next to him. Step 1: lower cat over the pink to above-left of the guard, hop into the upper cat.
calls.status: You are the cat now. Z to undo.

calls.note: Upper cat goes under the parked cat and into the guard. Then guard steps up and hops left into the parked cat.
calls.status: The gate shuts: no body on a plate.

calls.note: Gate shut as expected. Relay: left into cat, down into the other cat, onto the plate, up into the guard, out through the door.
calls.status: Out in 19 turns (par!). That's the whole main game. Night shift has harder levels if you want more: press N.
